technical-summary: Retired AS101 Slice 1's agents-owned ComputeResource/ModelInstance taxonomy (models/compute_resource.py, compute_resource_api.py, model_instance.py, model_instance_api.py, 10 MCP tools, agents_paths.py path helpers, CRES/MINST error codes, test_agents_compute_taxonomy.py) after an ownership correction: providers already owns a master model catalog (model-sources.yaml) with its own provider-projection mechanism. Extended the existing model-sources.yaml schema/loader instead — optional resource-id/concurrency fields on local-endpoint sources, resolved at both user-global (audiagentic_home()/config/model-sources.yaml, shared hardware, new) and project-local (existing, unchanged) tiers via load_layered_config. Added load_resolved_model_sources() as a read-only merged view, deliberately kept separate from load_model_sources()/write_model_sources() to prevent a project-local mutation from silently copying inherited global sources into that project's file. Added providers_api.py CRUD for the user-global tier (model_source_list_global/add_global/update_global/remove_global/set_enabled_global) plus model_source_list_resolved, and 6 corresponding MCP tools on the existing ag-providers-mgmt server.
user-summary-candidate: Model capacity (concurrency, which GPU) for shared local inference endpoints is now declared once via the existing provider model-source config and shared across every project, instead of needing a separate per-project or per-agent declaration.

technical-summary: Implemented AS105's free-instance dispatch design (AS101 Slices 2-3): ExecutionProfile.model_id replaced by instances: tuple[str,...] naming providers' model-sources.yaml source-ids (contract-version v2). ResolvedExecutionProfile drops model_id/max_concurrency/queue_max_size/admission_policy_digest; GatewayExecutionLaneKey retired outright. queue.py's per-lane BoundedSemaphore replaced by a hybrid model: a profile's instances are either fully gated (every source declares resource-id+concurrency, dispatched via new _ResourceCapacityTracker with drain-before-swap + bounded anti-starvation guard, bound only at dispatch time, per-project round-robin fairness across resource contention) or fully ungated (no source declares capacity, exact legacy per-lane-semaphore behavior preserved for backward compat). Old shared-gateway-snapshot records lacking resolved-instance-ids fail closed with VAL-EXP-006 rather than misparsing. Investigation before coding surfaced 3 additional real call sites not in the original design (gateway/queue/dispatch.py, gateway/session/dispatch.py re-resolving profile.model_id directly; contracts/execution_context.py's ManifestIdentity hard-requiring non-empty model_id at admission, blocking deferred binding structurally) plus a legacy agent_jobs/prompt_launch.py resolver with the same contract -- all fixed. Full tests/unit/agents and tests/unit/providers regression green except confirmed pre-existing unrelated failures.
user-summary-candidate: The gateway can now dispatch a request to whichever of several equivalent model instances (e.g. the same model loaded on two GPUs) has spare capacity, instead of being limited to one fixed model per execution profile -- and can no longer accidentally over-subscribe shared hardware.
